project.name: osgi/domains/cluster-pki
project.description: The cluster-pki domain: the deterministic cluster CA, minted host-side once per cluster and rooted on the operator's existing ndh mammoth-skate-tls TLS root. cluster-pki-core holds the pure BouncyCastle CA-hierarchy generator (intermediate + the five rke2 leaf CAs + the service-account issuer key, faithful to k3s generate-custom-ca-certs.sh); cluster-pki-edge is the sops-encrypt door (the node consumes the bundle via sops-nix); cluster-pki-bdd is the seal scion that reads the ndh root, generates the set, seals it, and files it in the cellar for the GROW to pose over devlxd. See docs/architecture/cluster-api/deterministic-cluster-access.adoc.
